C13 similarly praises organized programs and their contributions to international cooperation, while C12 links personal achievement with building friendship for America; neither shares a distinctive formulation or parallel sequence sufficient to establish reuse.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"I am happy to send my warm greetings to the members who will participate in the forthcoming Ninth Inter-American Medical Cruise Congress","parent_excerpt":"To the Fifteenth Constitutional Convention of the Congress of Industrial Organizations, I extend greetings and good wishes.","explanation":"C11 shares the routine function of presidential greetings to an organization's convention, but not distinctive wording or a materially parallel structure."},{"child_excerpt":"the program you have pursued during the past twenty-six years of interchanging medical knowledge and friendship among the doctors of this hemisphere","parent_excerpt":"On this third anniversary of the adoption by Congress of the Greek-Turkish aid program, it is appropriate that public recognition be given to the men and women...","explanation":"C13 likewise commends the history and achievements of a program, but this is generic praise and is directed to public servants rather than members attending an association event."},{"child_excerpt":"certainly promotes understanding and cooperation among the American nations","parent_excerpt":"an envoy extraordinary in the business of building friendship for America","explanation":"C12 shares the broad motif of fostering international friendship, but provides no concrete drafting machinery or distinctive shared language."}]}
